recent_excerpts: ShinyHunters defaced fbijobs.gov and gave the FBI one week to retract a May PSA, claiming 2-3 TB stolen via a PeopleSoft flaw tracked as CVE-2026-35273.
Five Venezuelan nationals pleaded guilty to bank larceny for ATM jackpotting in Kansas. FBI reports over $58M in losses since 2021 and 1,900 incidents since 2020.
CISA and FBI joint advisory details LummaC2 infostealer TTPs and IOCs: malware steals credentials, crypto wallets, and session data from compromised networks.
